appln_title: OPTICAL SYSTEM AND DEVICE USING THE SAME
appln_abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an observation optical system for a display device which is utilized with high efficiency at a plurality of wavelengths, is bright and good in color reproducibility and makes display image observation well corrected to obtain aberrations possible and an imaging optical system. SOLUTION: This optical system includes volume hologram elements 6 joined and arranged between a first prism 3 and a second prism 4. The hologram elements 6 includes the first volume hologram optimized to make Bragg diffraction at least at the first wavelength and the second volume hologram optimized to make Bragg diffraction at the second wavelength different from the first wavelength. The shapes and intervals of the interference fringes of the hologram surfaces of the first volume hologram and second volume hologram of the hologram elements 6 are the same as each other and the spacings and inclinations of the interference fringes within the hologram media are different from each other.
exclusion_reason: Generic optical system; abstract does not establish a wearable eyewear application.
review_notes: Generic optical system; abstract does not establish a wearable eyewear application.

appln_title: Hand-free data acquisition system
appln_abstract: A wearable data acquisition system is described in which the data input devices are contained within a headpiece apparatus thereby permitting the operator to control acquisition integration of image capture and display in a hands free environment. The system includes a portable data terminal communicating with the headpiece apparatus which comprises an image acquisition device having a target pattern generator for providing visual feedback for aiming and range-finding, a microphone for receiving voice commands from a human operator to the portable data terminal, and a speaker whereby the human operator receives audio feedback from the portable data terminal. In another embodiment of the present invention, the headpiece apparatus further comprises an image display system having a scanning laser heads-up display for projecting image data into the vision field of the human operator. This image display system allows the human operator to preview an image to be captured or to recall stored image data from the memory of the portable data terminal.
exclusion_reason: Headpiece data-acquisition system; no eyeglass-form device is established.
review_notes: Headpiece data-acquisition system; no eyeglass-form device is established.

appln_title: PORTABLE ELECTRONIC SPECTACLE DEVICE
appln_abstract: There is provided a portable electronic spectacle device capable of easily and stably matching the convergence point of Maxwell's view within a range of eye pupil and enabling a user to carry the device at hand-free for a long time. The portable electronic spectacle device includes an optical unit (2) of the electronic spectacle body having an image emission unit (21) (eyepiece 21a) for emitting an image light of high directivity using the Maxwell's view; and a positioning mechanism unit (3) mounted at a center portion (23) of the electronic spectacle body as the optical unit (2) for holding it and attached to the edge of a hat or a spectacle frame for three-dimensionally positioning the optical unit (2) (positioning by movement along three axes and rotation around one axis) and fixing it.

appln_title: EYEWEAR HAVING HUMAN ACTIVITY MONITORING DEVICE
appln_abstract: A method for monitoring human activity using an inertial sensor includes obtaining acceleration measurement data from an inertial sensor disposed in eyewear. The acceleration measurement data is processed to determine a user activity statistic. The user activity statistic includes at least one of a current user activity, periodic human motion count, total distance traveled, vertical distance traveled, current speed and average speed.

appln_title: LOCAL ADVERTISING CONTENT ON AN INTERACTIVE HEAD-MOUNTED EYEPIECE
appln_abstract: This disclosure concerns an interactive head-mounted eyepiece including an optical assembly through which the user views a surrounding environment and displayed content. The displayed content includes a local advertisement, wherein the location of the eyepiece is determined by an integrated location sensor and wherein the local advertisement has a relevance to the location of the eyepiece. The head mounted eyepiece may also include an audio device and the displayed content may comprise local advertisements and audio.

appln_title: Systems and Methods for Speech Command Processing
appln_abstract: Methods and apparatus related to processing speech input at a wearable computing device are disclosed. Speech input can be received at the wearable computing device. Speech-related text corresponding to the speech input can be generated. A context can be determined based on database(s) and/or a history of accessed documents. An action can be determined based on an evaluation of at least a portion of the speech-related text and the context. The action can be a command or a search request. If the action is a command, then the wearable computing device can generate output for the command. If the action is a search request, then the wearable computing device can: communicate the search request to a search engine, receive search results from the search engine, and generate output based on the search results. The output can be provided using output component(s) of the wearable computing device.

appln_title: Method and apparatus for a near-to-eye display
appln_abstract: An eyepiece for a head mounted display includes an illumination module, an end reflector, a viewing region, and a polarization rotator. The illumination module provides CGI light along a forward propagation path within the eyepiece. The end reflector is disposed at an opposite end of the eyepiece from the illumination module to reflect the CGI light back along a reverse propagation path within the eyepiece. The viewing is disposed between the illumination module and the end reflector and includes an out-coupling polarizing beam splitter (“PBS”). The out-coupling PBS passes the CGI light traveling along the forward propagation path and redirects the CGI light traveling along the reverse propagation path out of an eye-ward side of the eyepiece. The polarization rotator is disposed in the forward and reverse propagation paths between the out-coupling PBS and the end reflector.

appln_title: Virtual image display apparatus
appln_abstract: An intermediate image is formed inside a first prism, and an image light, which is reflected on the order of a third surface, a first surface and a second surface, is transmitted through the first surface and reaches the eyes of the observer, therefore it is possible to make the entire optical system small and light in weight by making the first prism thin, and realize a high performance display device with a wide angle of view. Further, when an external light is passed through, for example, the first surface and the third surface and observed, a diopter scale is set to approximately zero, and thereby reducing the defocus or distortion of the external light when observed in a see-through manner. And, it is possible such that the shape of the first prism conforms to the face of the observer, the center is also close to the face.

appln_title: Gesture recognition system and glasses with gesture recognition function
appln_abstract: A glasses with gesture recognition including a glasses frame and a gesture recognition system is provided. A gesture recognition system is disposed on the glasses frame. The gesture recognition system is capable of sensing a hand motion being front of the glasses and outputs a control command. The gesture recognition system is capable of controlling an electric apparatus by transmitting the control command to the electrical apparatus.

appln_abstract: The invention relates to methods for augmented reality. The invention relates more particularly to methods for improving the visual comfort of a wearer equipped with a head-mounted display device.

appln_title: Content annotation
appln_abstract: Methods and systems for annotating objects and/or actions are provided. An example method includes receiving a selection of a content object via an interface of a wearable computing device. The wearable computing device may include a head-mounted display (HMD). The method may also include, but is not limited to, displaying the selected content object on the HMD. Additionally, the method may include obtaining facial-muscle information while the content object is being displayed on the HMD. A facial expression may also be determined based on the facial-muscle information. According to the method, the content object may be associated with an annotation comprising an indication of the facial expression.

appln_title: Apparatus and Method for Portable Device displaying Augmented Reality image
appln_abstract: The present invention relates to a portable device for displaying an augmented reality image and to a method therefor. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for displaying the augmented reality image displays the augmented reality image corresponding to a marker before the marker is displayed. The present invention includes the steps of: setting the view angle of a camera angle as a first view angle and the view angle of a display unit as a second view angle; detecting the marker at an angle between the second view angle and the first view angle if the second view angle is less than the first view angle; and displaying a first part of the augmented reality image corresponding to the marker, wherein the first part is a part of the augmented reality image to be located at the view angle less than the second view angle.

appln_title: Head mounted display and method of controlling therefor
appln_abstract: A method of controlling a head mounted display (HMD) according to one embodiment of the present specification includes performing a first operation, receiving a first voice input through an audio input unit, processing the first voice input with respect to the first operation while a first contact is detected through a first sensor positioned at a nose pad of the HMD, detecting the first contact being released through the first sensor positioned at a nose pad of the HMD, receiving a second voice input through the audio input unit while the first contact is released, and performing a second operation according to the received second voice input.

appln_title: Weight-distributing headband for head-worn assembly
appln_abstract: A head-worn assembly is disclosed including a head-worn device supported on a headband. The headband may include a first loop positioned around the head, and possibly a second loop affixed to the first loop and positioned over the head. Weight distribution and comfort of the head-worn assembly may be optimized by mounting the head-worn device at an approximate center (front to back) of the headband, and further balancing the weight of the head-worn device (front to back) over the mounting point. The weight distribution and comfort of the head-worn assembly may be further optimized by providing several user-customizable adjustments to the head-worn assembly.

appln_title: Using sounds for determining a worn state of a wearable computing device
appln_abstract: Methods, apparatus, and computer-readable media are described herein related to using self-generated sounds for determining a worn state of a wearable computing device. A wearable computing device can transmit an audio signal. One or more sensors coupled to the wearable computing device may then receive a modified version of the audio signal. A comparison may be made between the modified version of the audio signal and at least one reference signal, where the at least one reference signal is based on the audio signal that is transmitted. Based on an output of the comparison, a determination can be made of whether the wearable computing device is being worn.

appln_title: Glove interface object with thumb-index controller
appln_abstract: A glove interface object is provided, comprising: an index finger portion; a resistance circuit including an index resistor defined along a length of the index finger portion, and a power source for applying a current across the index resistor; a thumb portion; a probe circuit including a thumb contact defined on the thumb portion, the probe circuit configured to read a voltage, via the thumb contact, at a location along the length of the index resistor at which contact between the thumb contact and the index resistor occurs; a data processing module for processing the voltage read by the probe circuit to generate thumb-index control data that is indicative of the location at which the contact between the thumb contact and the index resistor occurs; a communications module configured to send the thumb-index control data to a computing device for processing to define a setting for a virtual environment.

appln_abstract: A method for maintenance support comprising interaction between an maintainer at an maintenance area and an expert at a remote located expert, wherein the method comprises the following steps: ¢ detection of an object to be maintained by analyzing video data generated by a head mounted camera; ¢ streaming of the video data from the maintainer to the expert; ¢ transmission of support data from the expert to the maintainer; is characterized in that the support data comprise pointer data for creating a pointer to be displayed to the maintainer, wherein the pointer is assigned to the detected object, and the pointer is displayed at a see-through display of augmented reality glasses.

appln_title: COMPACT HEAD-MOUNTED DISPLAY SYSTEM HAVING UNIFORM IMAGE
appln_abstract: There is disclosed an optical device, including a light-transmitting substrate having an input aperture, an output aperture, at least two major surfaces and edges, an optical element for coupling light waves into the substrate by total internal reflection, at least one partially reflecting surface located between the two major surfaces of the light-transmitting substrate for partially reflecting light waves out of the substrate, a first transparent plate, having at least two major surfaces, one of the major surfaces of the transparent plate being optically attached to a major surface of the light-transmitting substrate defining an interface plane, and a beam-splitting coating applied at the interface plane between the substrate and the transparent plate, wherein light waves coupled inside the light- transmitting substrate are partially reflected from the interface plane and partially pass therethrough.

appln_title: Virtual reality glasses device and top cover device thereof
appln_abstract: The invention discloses the top cover device of a virtual reality glasses device. The top cover device is used for fixing a mobile terminal installed in a virtual reality glasses device; the outer rim of the top cover device is provided with a buckle structure extending vertically, wherein one side of the buckle structure is provided with a grooving structure; the grooving structure and a main body structure form an easy-to-open structure when the top cover device and the main body structure of the virtual reality glasses device are jointed. The vertical buckle structure fixes the top cover device and other components of the virtual reality glasses device; one side of the buckle structure is provided with a groove; the grooving structure is adjacent with the buckle structure; a finger or an auxiliary object is easy to extend into the grooving structure, thereby uncovering the top cover device through simple operation; in addition, the main body structure can be provided with a slot matching the grooving structure to form an easy-to-open structure, thereby further facilitating operator operation of folding and unfolding the top cover device. The invention also provides a virtual reality glasses device.

appln_title: DISPLAY DEVICE, CONTROL METHOD FOR DISPLAY DEVICE, AND PROGRAM
appln_abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device for outputting an image and a sound in which a reduction in listenability due to an influence of an external environmental sound and the like is prevented without impairing convenience.SOLUTION: An HMD100 comprises: a display section 20 for making an external scenery transparent while allowing a user to visually recognize an image; and a right earphone 32 and a left earphone 34 for outputting a sound. The HMD100 includes: sound output processing for allowing the right earphone 32 and the left earphone 34 to output the sound corresponding to the image displayed by the image display section 20; sound processing for the sound output by the right earphone 32 and the left earphone 34; or processing for the image displayed by the image display section 20. appln_title: Augmented reality display device and augmented reality glasses
appln_abstract: An embodiment of the invention provides an augmented reality display device and augmented reality glasses. The device comprises a refraction adjustable module, a transparent display module and a control module, wherein the refraction adjustable module and the transparent display module are stacked and have a preset distance, and the control module is respectively electrically connected to the refraction adjustable module and the transparent display module. In a first display time domain, the control module is used for controlling the transparent display module, so that the transparent display module is in an all-transparent state, the refraction adjustable module is controlled, and light passing the refraction adjustable module is not refracted. In a second display time domain, the control module is used for controlling the transparent display module, so that the transparent display module displays images, the refraction adjustable module is controlled, and the displayed images are amplified by the refraction adjustable module. By means of time division multiplexing, virtual and real scenes are integrated, and the augmented reality display device and the augmented reality glasses are simple in structure.

appln_title: HEAD MOUNTED DISPLAY AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING THE SAME
appln_abstract: The present invention relates to a head mounted display (HMD) capable of receiving an image through a camera. The HMD according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a main body configured to be worn on a users head; a camera equipped in the main body; a sensing unit configured to measure the distance between the main body and a subject corresponding to the image received through the camera; and a control unit which determines a plurality of feature points satisfying preset conditions in the image, measures the distance between the main body and the subject corresponding to at least one of the feature points by using the sensing unit, and determines the movement of the main body on the basis of at least one of the feature points and the measured distance.

appln_title: Method and device for measuring depth of field of virtual reality helmet based on image scales
appln_abstract: The invention provides a method and device for measuring the depth of field of a virtual reality helmet based on image scales. The device comprises a test unit, an observation unit, an image unit and a processing unit, wherein the test unit comprises the virtual reality helmet to be set and a fixing structure, and the virtual reality helmet to be set is composed of a display screen; the fixing structure comprises a clamping tool and a limiting mechanism, and the clamping tool can be opened and put into the virtual reality helmet. Compared with the prior art, the method and device achieve the purpose of measuring the depth of field simply and effectively by using the combination of the test unit, the observation unit, the image unit and the processing unit. Driven by a motor, the observation unit moves along an eyepiece track, which facilitates observing from multiple angles and setting of multiple observation points.

appln_title: EYE TRACKING FOR HEAD-WORN DISPLAY
appln_abstract: A display assembly (105) for mounting on a head-worn device such as a helmet, and having a partially reflective surface located in a field of view of a user, a display projector (40, 50, 200) for projecting light towards the user via the partially reflective surface, a sensor (60, 210) for use in tracking an eye of the user, and a partially reflective imaging surface (120, 220, 225) located in the field of view. The sensor is aligned to receive light forming an image of an eye reflected by the partially reflective imaging surface, the image being for use in the eye-tracking. By using a reflected image, the camera location can be arranged to improve the potentially conflicting needs of keeping the field of view clear, and of having an image from directly in front of the eye, and of limiting the weight and size and imbalance of the helmet. The visor may be used as the partially reflective surface. IR Illumination may be provided by the display projector.

review_notes: Helmet/visor display rather than eyeglass-form smart eyewear.

appln_title: CONNECTORS FOR ATTACHING ONE OR MORE WEARABLE DEVICES TO EYEWEAR
appln_abstract: A connector assembly comprising a base having an adapter and a retainer, the adapter configured to reversibly couple to a wearable device using a magnet, ferromagnetic material, or combinations thereof; an elastic member partially positioned within the retainer, the elastic member having a first loop portion adjacent a first end of the retainer and a second loop portion adjacent a second end of the retainer; and wherein the elastic member is configured to stretchably move with respect to the base such that, responsive to a force pulling the first loop portion over a portion of an eyewear frame, the second loop portion changes in size.

appln_title: Intelligent glasses and signal conversion method
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a pair of intelligent glasses and a signal conversion method. The intelligent glasses comprise a master control terminal and a glasses terminal, wherein the master control terminal comprises a first interface, a first signal transceiving unit and a master control processing module which are electrically connected in sequence; the glasses terminal comprises a data acquisition module, an output module and a second interface, a second signal transceiving unit and a glasses processing module which are electrically connected in sequence; the data acquisition module and the output module are both electrically connected with the glasses processing module; the first interface and the second interface are typec interfaces which are adapted to each other; and the master control terminal and the glasses terminal are mutually connected by the first interface and the second interface. The method improves the adapting capacity and the uniformity of the intelligent glasses, and is favorable for the popularization of the intelligent glasses and the promotion of use experience.

appln_title: Multifunctional healthcare glasses for promoting sleeping
appln_abstract: The invention provides a pair of multifunctional healthcare glasses for promoting sleeping, relating to the technical field of glasses. The glasses comprise glass frames, a glass beam and glass legs,wherein the head of each glass leg is connected with the glass frame, the tail of each glass leg is provided with a positioning module, an earphone jack and a massage anti-fall device, sounds are arranged in the middle of the glass legs, the head of each glass leg is provided with a vibration device, a Bluetooth module, a storage battery, a charging port, a functional key and a volume adjusting knob in sequence, the lower edge of each glass frame is provided with a microphone, the glass beam is provided with a green lamp device and a green light nose support, the massage anti-fall device comprises a massage anti-fall body and a fixing ring, the green lamp device is connected with the green light nose support, the Bluetooth module is connected with the sound, the earphone jack and the microphone, the storage battery and the functional key are each connected with the Bluetooth module, the vibration module and the green lamp device, and the storage battery is connected with the functionalkey. The multifunctional healthcare glasses for promoting sleeping can effectively regulate the circadian rhythm to improve sleeping quality, can be connected with a mobile phone so as to answer an incoming call through one key, and has functions of preventing falling in wearing, massaging and positioning.

The projection display apparatus comprises: the eye tracker for tracking the eyes of the user; and a projector projecting an image. The image is projected onto a first region at a first resolution based on the eye position of the user or is projected onto a second region except the first region at a second resolution lower than the first resolution or is not projected.

appln_title: EYEGLASSES-MOUNTED TYPE WEARABLE APPARATUS HAVING NECK DISEASE WARNING FUNCTION
appln_abstract: According to an aspect of the present invention, provided is an eyeglasses-wearable device with a neck disease warning function. The eyeglasses-wearable device with a neck disease warning function comprises: a case (110) disposed on eyeglasses temples (11) of eyeglasses (10) worn by a user; a sensor (120) mounted inside the case (110) and sensing a tilt angle of the eyeglasses temples (11) which is changed by a user′s bowing motion; a display unit (130) mounted inside the case (110), and displaying a neck disease warning to the outside in a display manner such as light emission, vibration, or sound when the tilt angle sensed by the sensor (120) exceeds a predetermined neck disease risk angle (θ1); and a battery (140) supplying driving power required for a display operation of the display unit (130).

appln_title: Focal length-freely adjustable eyeglasses for virtual reality and adjustment method thereof
appln_abstract: The invention discloses focal length-freely adjustable eyeglasses for virtual reality. The eyeglasses comprise a eyeglasses shell, a first lens and a second lens; grooves matched with the first lens and the second lens are formed in the eyeglasses shell; the first lens includes a first frame, a first eyeglass, and a first adjustment ring for adjusting the focal length of the first lens; the secondlens includes a second frame, a second eyeglass, and a second adjustment ring for adjusting the focal length of the second lens; the second lens and the second frame are fixedly connected with each other; the first frame and the second frame are both provided with protrusions; insertion slots which are matched with the protrusions are formed in the eyeglasses shell; the first lens and the secondlens are fixedly connected with the eyeglasses shell through the protrusions and the insertion portions; the head ends of the first lens and the second lens are both provided with protective covers; and the first lens and the second lens are in threaded connection with the protective covers corresponding to the first lens and the second lens. The focal length of the focal length-freely adjustableeyeglasses for virtual reality can be effectively adjusted.

appln_title: Intelligent glasses
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a pair of intelligent glasses. The intelligent glasses comprise a glasses body, at least a sensor, and a signal processing module. The sensor is arranged at a contacting part of the glasses body and human skin, the sensor outputs a sensing signal according to a preset motion of human body, the signal processing module is embedded in the glasses body, is electrically connected with the sensor, and is used for receiving and processing the sensing signal, and the intelligent glasses can be controlled to execute the corresponding operation according to the processed sensingsignal. The pair of the intelligent glasses is capable of executing the corresponding intelligent operation according to the preset motion of human body, has the advantages of simple structure and low cost, and is suitable for large-scale production.

appln_title: Magic helmet device
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a magic helmet device. The magic helmet device comprises an operating display platform and a magic helmet, wherein a light assembly is arranged on the operation display platform and is used for stabilizing constant light brightness of the operation display platform, the magic helmet is connected with the operation display platform, a computer chip, a camera, AR glasses, scanning equipment and a projector are arranged on the magic helmet, and the camera, the AR glasses, the scanning equipment and the projector are connected with the computer chip. By arrangement of the computer chip, the camera, the AR glasses, the scanning equipment and the projector on the magic helmet, the labor and the material resources can be greatly reduced; and meanwhile, a performer cannot view during the operation process, and thus, the performing stage effect cannot be perfectly displayed when a problem occurs.

appln_title: SYSTEMS, DEVICES, AND METHODS FOR EMBEDDING A DIFFRACTIVE ELEMENT IN AN EYEGLASS LENS
appln_abstract: Systems, devices, and methods for embedding a diffractive element in an eyeglass lens are described. A method of embedding a diffractive element in an eyeglass lens includes applying a protective layer to a diffractive element, applying an interface layer to the protective layer, and applying a lens layer to the interface layer. The interface layer and the lens layer are each comprised of a resin material that hardens when cured. The interface layer is of a shape and thickness that adheres well to the protective layer after the interface layer is cured. The lens layer is of a shape and thickness that achieves the desired component shape of the lens after the lens layer is cured.

appln_title: Method and device for adjusting near-eye display device, equipment and storage medium
appln_abstract: The application discloses a method and device for adjusting a near-eye display device, equipment and a storage medium. The method includes the following steps that: according to infrared data collected by an infrared sensor arranged at a light emitting side of a near-eye display device, pupil center positions of two eyes of a user are determined, wherein the infrared sensor includes a plurality ofinfrared light emitters and at least one infrared light receiver; and on the basis of the pupil center positions of two eyes of the user, positions of the two lenses in the near-eye display device are adjusted and thus the centers of two lenses are overlapped with the pupil centers of the two eyes of the user in a one-to-one correspondence manner. Therefore, a display effect corresponding to theown pupil distance is provided for the user when the user uses a near-eye display device, so that the viewing experience of the user is improved effectively.

appln_title: OPTICAL SYSTEM OF HYBRID REALITY WITH DIGITAL CORRECTION OF ABERRATIONS
appln_abstract: FIELD: information technology.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to head-mounted systems of hybrid reality. Head-mounted display includes an optical system and an oculography system. At the same time, the display provides for obtaining mixed data consisting of computer-generated data, or real images, or a combination of them; incoming image obtained by the optical system, formed by the specified mixed data, where the optical aberrations are included in the specified input image by the specified optical system; 'Digital lenses' for the correction of optical aberrations, consisting of the first and second actions for the optimal correction of the optical aberrations of the specified optical system. First action is carried out before the second action and involves the collection of data from the eyepiece and the creation of a profile of the optical system, including data from the eyepiece. Second action involves the formation of the oculography data by the oculography system, the formation of the corrected image with the indicated optical aberrations eliminated by applying the optical system profile and the oculography data, the formation of the corrected image shown to the user.EFFECT: invention provides for the correction of aberrations without introducing additional optical elements into the design.20 cl, 9 dwg

appln_title: EYEPIECE OPTICAL SYSTEM AND IMAGE DISPLAY DEVICE
appln_abstract: To provide an eyepiece optical system and an image display device that prevent a reduction in video quality and the occurrence of chipping of a video.SOLUTION: An eyepiece optical system 100 is an eyepiece optical system 100 that emits rays of image light emitted from a plurality of display elements 2a, 2b and corresponding to a plurality of division areas to a position corresponding to the eye of an observer. In a compound first optical member 11 corresponding to at least two areas of the plurality of areas and arranged closest to the emission side, a first optical surface 11f on the emission side is a curved surface represented by one curvature.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

appln_title: Head-mounted augmented reality glasses system and implementation method thereof
appln_abstract: The invention provides a head-mounted augmented reality glasses system and an implementation method thereof and belongs to the intelligent wearing technical field of speech recognition, augmented reality technology and human-computer interaction. The system comprises a central processing unit, an image acquisition module, a projection display module, a speech acquisition module and a power sourcemodule. The method comprises the following steps that: image and speech information is collected; the speech information is recognized, and voiceprint extraction is carried out; noise reduction and amplification processing are performed on the speech information, the distance and type of the speech information are judged, and classification processing is performed on the speech information; the speech information is matched with the image information, and motion recognition and tracking are performed on the image information matched with the speech information; and augmentation processing is performed on the final image information, and then, projection display is performed. appln_abstract: The invention discloses an AR image shooting method and device, a storage medium and AR equipment. For a plurality of the detected sounds, the audio system performs a direction of arrival (DoA) estimation. Based on parameters of the detected sound and/or the DoA estimation, the audio system may then generate or update one or more acoustic transfer functions unique to a user. The audio system may use the one or more acoustic transfer functions to generate audio content for the user.

appln_title: Intelligent glasses control method and intelligent glasses
appln_abstract: The invention is applicable to the technical field of intelligent glasses and provides an intelligent glasses control method, intelligent glasses and a computer readable storage medium. The intelligent glasses control method comprises the steps: determining the state of a first glasses leg of the intelligent glasses and/or a second glasses leg of the intelligent glasses according to first sensingdata detected by a first sensor of the intelligent glasses; if the state of the first glasses leg and/or the second glasses leg accords with a preset state, obtaining second sensing data detected by asecond sensor of the intelligent glasses, wherein the first sensor and the second sensor are arranged at different positions of the intelligent glasses; and determining an operation mode of the intelligent glasses according to the second sensing data. According to the internet image processing method, the acquisition mode of the source image can be flexibly switched; and especially for a source image of an Internet image, the source image is optimized through multiple image processing methods, so that a processed image which can be clearly, completely and visually seen by a user wearing the AR equipment and has high identification degree is obtained, and particularly for a user with low eyesight, the eyesight of the user is effectively improved, and the life quality is greatly improved.

The plurality of advertisements are filtered to generate one or more filtered advertisements for the users at least in part by determining that 1) the geographic location associated with the advertisement is within the geofence of the user and 2) is according to the user preferences. The one or more filtered advertisements are provided to the users in response to filtering the plurality of advertisements.

A determination unit (62) determines whether an operator of the unmanned aerial vehicle is viewing the unmanned aerial vehicle on the basis of sensing data relating to the unmanned aerial vehicle and/or relating the operator. appln_title: 5G Internet-of-things VR equipment
appln_abstract: The invention discloses 5G Internet-of-things VR equipment, which comprises a shell, an eyepiece assembly, a clamping assembly and a shell cover. appln_title: Waveguide display with structured light for eye and face tracking
appln_abstract: A near-eye-display (NED) includes a tracking system and a waveguide assembly. The waveguide assembly includes an infrared (IR) light source and an output waveguide. The output waveguide includes at least a decoupling element that outcouples the IR light emitted by the IR light source to form the structured light pattern. The structured light pattern is projected toward one or more regions of a user's face, for example, the user's eyes. The structured light pattern is reflected off the one or more regions of the user's face and captured by the tracking system. The tracking system can determine tracking information such as eye tracking information as well as face tracking information based on the captured reflected structured light pattern.

appln_title: Hinge and wearable device

appln_title: MULTI-PURPOSE CAMERAS FOR AUGMENTED REALITY AND COMPUTER VISION APPLICATIONS
appln_abstract: Eyewear having an image signal processor (ISP) dynamically operable in a camera pipeline for augmented reality (AR) and computer vision (CV) systems. The cameras and the ISP save significant system power by operating in the low power mode CV mode.

appln_title: Underwater intelligent glasses

appln_title: XR glasses, camera adjustment method, system and equipment, and medium
appln_abstract: The invention discloses XR glasses, a camera adjusting method, a camera adjusting system, equipment and a medium, and is applied to a controller installed on the XR glasses, target adjusting information collected by an information collector installed on the XR glasses is obtained, and the target adjusting information comprises information for adjusting a target camera on the XR glasses; analyzing the target adjustment information to obtain a target adjustment parameter for adjusting the target camera; and sending the target adjustment parameter to a target adjustment device which is installed on the XR glasses and corresponds to the target camera, so that the target adjustment device adjusts the shooting angle of the target camera based on the target adjustment parameter. appln_title: Virtual image distance adjusting mechanism and near-eye display
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a virtual image distance adjusting mechanism and a near-to-eye display, the virtual image distance adjusting mechanism comprises a display screen mounting bracket, an optical lens group mounting bracket, a rotating bracket and two fixing blocks, the rotating bracket is rotatably arranged on the display screen mounting bracket and can rotate around a fixed rotating shaft; the rotating support comprises an arc-shaped support with a handle, two connecting supports and two arc-shaped threaded supports, and the two ends of the arc-shaped support are connected with the arc-shaped threaded supports through the connecting supports respectively; the arc-shaped threaded bracket and the arc-shaped bracket are arranged on a concentric circle taking the position of the rotating shaft as a circle center; an external thread is arranged on the outer side of the arc-shaped threaded bracket; the two fixed blocks are fixed on the optical lens group mounting bracket; the fixing block is provided with an arc-shaped internal thread matched with the external thread; the rotating support rotates around the rotating shaft by shifting the handle, the distance between the display screen mounting support and the optical lens group mounting support is changed under the action of the external threads and the internal threads, and virtual image distance adjustment is achieved.

appln_abstract: A system includes a computing platform having processing hardware, one or more sensor(s), and a memory storing perception software and animation software, as well as an augmented reality (AR) headset including another processing hardware. The computing platform is configured to obtain an environmental data using the sensor(s), determine the location and orientation of the AR headset using the perception software and the environmental data, identify an action for execution by the computing platform, using the animation software and the location and orientation of the AR headset, and transmit performative data corresponding to the identified action to the AR headset. appln_title: WEARABLE ELECTRONIC DEVICE DISPLAYING VIRTUAL OBJECT AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING SAME
appln_abstract: A wearable electronic device may comprise a display, a camera, at least one first sensor, and at least one processor operatively connected to the display, the camera, and the at least one first sensor. The at least one processor may: display an execution screen of an application on the display; when a first user input for selecting one of a plurality of content included in the execution screen of the application is received through the camera, display a first virtual object related to the selected content on the display; when a second user input for mapping the first virtual object to an object included in a real space is received through the camera, identify the type of object in the real space through the at least one first sensor; if the type of object in the real space is related to the selected content or the first virtual object, display a second virtual object related to the selected content on the display on the basis of at least one of the shape, position, or size of the object in the real space; and if the type of object in the real space is not related to the selected content or the first virtual object, display a third virtual object in the form of a 3D object related to the selected content on the display.

appln_title: Device for monitoring intraocular pressure under VR screen
appln_abstract: The invention discloses an intraocular pressure monitoring device under a VR screen. The system comprises VR glasses; the piezoelectric ultrasonic transducer array is provided with a plurality of PMUT units, is located in the VR glasses and is used for collecting cornea thickness information by transmitting ultrasonic signals; the microprocessor is used for judging whether the intraocular pressure value is abnormal or not according to the cornea thickness information and closing the VR glasses when the intraocular pressure value is abnormal. According to the technical scheme, the piezoelectric micromechanical ultrasonic transducer array is embedded into the VR glasses, the ultrasonic transducers measure the cornea thickness change by emitting ultrasonic waves and feed back the cornea thickness change to the microprocessor for data processing, and when the cornea thickness change value reaches a preset value, the microprocessor judges that the intraocular pressure value is abnormal at the moment and closes the VR glasses when the intraocular pressure value is abnormal. The user is forced to enter a rest mode, reasonable time distribution of the VR glasses user is ensured, and safe eye use is achieved. The intraocular pressure monitoring is real-time, the eye state of a VR glasses user can be dynamically monitored, and measurement burden cannot be caused to the user while safe eye use is ensured.

appln_title: Control method and mobile device in immersive system
appln_abstract: A control method for an immersive system includes following steps. A communication is established between a mobile device and a head-mounted display device. Pose data of the mobile device is captured. A touch event is detected by a touch screen on the mobile device. An interface layout is defined on the touch screen, and the interface layout includes a plurality of functional regions. A target function is selected from candidate functions by mapping a position of the touch event with one of the functional regions in the interface layout. The target function is executed and an immersive content displayed by the head-mounted display device is rendered according to the target function and the pose data.

appln_title: ELECTRONIC DEVICE
appln_abstract: The present invention relates to an electronic device, such as a wearable display, for enabling a wider field of view (FOV), and may provide an electronic device comprising: a transparent substrate; a light source module array provided on a first surface of the transparent substrate and having a plurality of light source modules arranged into a grid structure; an optical array provided on a second surface of the transparent substrate and having a plurality of optical elements arranged so as to correspond to the plurality of light source modules, respectively; and an optical drive unit for controlling the light source module array, wherein external light is provided to a user through spaces between the plurality of light source modules and spaces between the plurality of optical elements, and a light beam from an image generated in the optical drive unit is emitted from the light source module array and provided to the user through the optical array.

appln_title: autofocus glasses
appln_abstract: The present invention is to provide auto-focusing glasses, which conveniently solve vision problems of myopia, hyperopia and presbyopia by calculating the distance to a subject according to the field of view and automatically adjusting the prescription of the eyeglass lens according to the user's eyesight, and eliminate the inconvenience of fixed magnification eyeglasses. The auto-focusing glasses include a camera (110); a prescription extraction control unit (120) that calculates a distance from a subject by an image process of images of both eyes from the camera (110), calculates a lens prescription according to the wearer's eyesight, and outputs a control signal; a light-transmitting stretchable film (130) that forms a sealed space in which a working fluid (132) is filled on the inside of each lens hole (12) of a rim (11); an inlet/outlet (140) provided to allow the working fluid (132) to enter and exit the sealed space; an actuator that adjusts the prescription by controlling the curvature according to the stretching of the light-transmitting stretchable film (130) by injecting and discharging the working fluid (132) according to the control signal; and a battery (160) that supplies power necessary for operation.

appln_title: Panoramic simulation experience VR glasses for research
appln_abstract: The invention provides a pair of study panoramic simulation experience VR glasses, which is applied to the technical field of VR glasses, and is characterized by comprising a glasses body and an adjusting belt connected with the glasses body, the glasses body comprises a shell, a film watching screen fixed on one side of the shell and a circuit board fixed in the shell; the LED lamp further comprises heat dissipation holes, and the multiple heat dissipation holes are formed in the shell. The heat dissipation mechanism is arranged in the shell and is opposite to the heat dissipation holes, and the circuit board is located between the heat dissipation holes and the heat dissipation mechanism; the dustproof mechanism is arranged in the shell and is used for shielding the heat dissipation holes when the heat dissipation mechanism stops heat dissipation; compared with the prior art, the circuit board cooling device has the technical effects that the operation of the cooling fan can be intelligently adjusted according to the actual use condition and the internal temperature, the circuit board is comprehensively and effectively cooled, and the stable performance of equipment can still be kept during high-strength use; meanwhile, dust is effectively prevented from entering the glasses, core parts are protected against pollution and damage, and the service life of equipment is prolonged.

appln_title: Anti-fatigue and anti-myopia glasses
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a pair of anti-fatigue and anti-myopia glasses in the technical field of glasses, which comprises a glasses frame, glasses legs are hinged to the surfaces of the two sides of the glasses frame, the glasses legs comprise glasses legs hinged to the side surfaces of the glasses frame, the interiors of the glasses legs are hollow, and fastening mechanisms are mounted in the glasses legs. An open hole is formed in the surface of one side, facing the head of a user, of each glasses leg, each fastening mechanism comprises an air bag mounted in the open hole in the surface of the corresponding glasses leg, an air pipe is fixedly connected to the interior of each glasses leg, the air pipes are communicated with the air bags, and the air pipes are filled with compressed air; according to the scheme, through the structural arrangement of the fastening mechanism, when the device is worn by different users, different tightness degrees of the heads of the users can be adjusted through the structural arrangement of the fastening mechanism, further, the device can be adaptively worn on the heads of the users, and the wearing firmness is kept; and the wearer is prevented from falling off in the daily activity process.

appln_title: Swappable battery for wearable devices
appln_abstract: A swappable battery and a swappable battery system for a near-eye device are described. In one aspect, the swappable battery may be detachably integrated into an outer surface of a near-eye device such that the swappable battery may be easily removable and replaceable by the user. In another aspect, the lid of the swappable battery may form an outer surface of the near-eye device when the swappable battery is attached. In some examples, the swappable battery may be detachably attached within a temple arm of a pair of smartglasses such that the outer surface of the swappable battery and the outer surface of the temple arm are substantially contiguous and flush.

appln_title: System and method for identifying identity through intelligent glasses and intelligent mobile terminal
appln_abstract: The invention relates to a system and method for identifying identity through intelligent glasses and an intelligent mobile terminal.The system comprises the intelligent glasses, the intelligent mobile terminal connected with the intelligent glasses and a cloud server configured with a large language model, and the intelligent glasses control a camera to shoot a person in front of a user; a shot image and a first voice instruction of a user are sent to the intelligent mobile terminal, the intelligent mobile terminal carries out face matching on the image and a photo of a contact person in a photo album address book, and contact person data information of a target contact person corresponding to the matched photo and first prompt information are input into a large language model; and the large language model generates a first voice reply according to the contact information and the first prompt information, and sends the first voice reply to the intelligent glasses for playing through the intelligent mobile terminal. appln_abstract: The invention discloses a virtual reality-based display device for power cloud classroom teaching, which is characterized in that a first electric telescopic rod is started to drive a negative pressure suction cup to move downwards so as to fix the negative pressure suction cup at a proper position, a second servo motor is started to drive a second electric telescopic rod to rotate out of a protective cylinder, and a user sits on a seat after wearing VR glasses, so that the user can sit on the display device for power cloud classroom teaching. appln_title: Rotating shaft structure applied in virtual reality or augmented reality glasses, and glasses
appln_abstract: The present invention discloses a rotating shaft structure applied in virtual reality or augmented reality glasses, and a glasses. The rotating shaft structure includes a first housing, a second housing, an annular frame, an elastic body and a rotating shaft. The first housing has a guide groove, and the guide groove includes two retaining walls and a concavity located between the retaining walls. The second housing is relatively rotatable and disposed cooperating with the first housing, and at least a portion of the second housing is located within the first housing. The annular frame is rotatably disposed in the first housing and engaged with the second housing, and has a positioning post extending toward to a direction of the guide groove. The positioning post is disposed corresponding to the guide groove, and the positioning post can resist the guide groove and move relative to the guide groove. The two ends of the elastic body are respectively connected to the first hosing and the annular frame. The rotating shaft passes through the first housing, the elastic body and the annular frame; when the first housing rotates relative to the second housing through the rotating shaft, it rotates relative to the annular frame at the same time, causing the annular frame to move relative to the guide grooves, and the positioning post selectively stops at the retaining walls or the concavity.

appln_title: Respiration rehabilitation training device for lung cancer patient

appln_title: Virtual image display device and optical unit
appln_abstract: The present invention relates to a virtual image display device and an optical unit, the virtual image display device comprising: a display that emits circularly polarized image light; and an optical member that forms a virtual image by reflecting the image light twice, the optical member having: a lens member; the transmission type reflective optical element is arranged opposite to a first optical surface, close to the display, of the lens component; a reflective polarizing optical element which is provided so as to face a second optical surface of the lens member, said second optical surface being away from the display, and which reflects image light that is linearly polarized light in the first polarization direction; and a wavelength plate element that is provided between the reflective optical element and the polarizing optical element, converts the image light that has passed through the reflective optical element into linearly polarized light in a first polarization direction, and converts the image light that has been reflected back and forth by the reflective optical element into linearly polarized light in a second polarization direction. appln_title: SMART GLASSES
appln_abstract: The present invention relates to smart glasses. The smart glasses according to the present invention comprise: a lens frame to which a pair of lenses is coupled; a pair of temple frames hinged to the lens frame; and a flexible printed circuit board (FPCB) that electrically connects the lenses and the electronic components disposed inside the temple frames, wherein the temple frames include: an outer cover that defines an internal space in which the electronic components are disposed; an inner cover coupled to the outer cover and including a contact portion that contacts a user's skin; and a first waterproof member and a second waterproof member formed in the internal space and preventing moisture from entering from outside, and wherein one surface of the flexible printed circuit board may contact the first waterproof member, and the other surface thereof may contact the second waterproof member.
